summary: Cost per fulfilled order (job or shipment); always added to route cost.
businessRules: per_order defines: Define the cost incurred by the vehicle for fulfilling one order. A job or a shipment, both are considered as a single order. When per_order cost is defined, the final vehicle cost is calculated as…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.costs. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: per_order cost balances serving more orders against the extra cost.
